title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Proprietary information stored on electronic and computing devices, whether owned or leased by <Company Name>, an employee, or a third party, remains the sole property of <Company Name>.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must ensure through legal or technical means that proprietary information is protected in accordance with the Data Protection Standard.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must promptly report the theft, loss, or unauthorized disclosure of <Company Name> proprietary information.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users may access, use, or share <Company Name> proprietary information only when authorized and necessary to fulfill assigned job duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must exercise good judgment regarding the reasonableness of personal use.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Individual departments must create guidelines concerning personal use of Internet, Intranet, and Extranet systems.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: In the absence of specific personal-use policies, employees should follow departmental policies and consult their supervisor or manager if uncertain.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Authorized individuals within <Company Name> may monitor equipment, systems, and network traffic at any time for security and network maintenance purposes, in accordance with Infosec's Audit Policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: <Company Name> may periodically audit networks and systems to ensure compliance with this policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: All mobile and computing devices that connect to the internal network must comply with the Minimum Access Policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: System-level and user-level passwords must comply with the Password Policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Providing access to another individual, either deliberately or through failure to secure access, is prohibited.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: All computing devices must use a password-protected lock screen configured to activate automatically after 10 minutes or less.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must lock the screen or log off when a device is unattended.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employee postings from a <Company Name> email address to newsgroups or other online platforms should state that the opinions expressed are the employee's own and not necessarily those of <Company Name>, unless posting is part of business duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must use extreme caution when opening email attachments from unknown senders because they may contain malware.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must not engage in any activity that violates local, state, federal, or international law while using <Company Name>-owned resources.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not violate rights protected by copyright, trade secret, patent, or similar laws or regulations, including by installing or distributing pirated or improperly licensed software.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Unauthorized copying, digitization, distribution, or installation of copyrighted material is prohibited, including software for which <Company Name> or the end user lacks an active license.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Accessing data, a server, or an account for any purpose other than conducting <Company Name> business is prohibited, even when the user otherwise has authorized access.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Software, technical information, encryption software, or technology must not be exported in violation of international or regional export-control laws; appropriate management must be consulted before exporting questionable material.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not introduce malicious programs, such as viruses, worms, Trojan horses, or ransomware, into a network or server.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not reveal their account password or passphrase to others or allow others, including family or household members, to use their account.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not use a <Company Name> computing asset to procure or transmit material that violates applicable sexual-harassment or hostile-workplace laws.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not make fraudulent offers of products, items, or services from any <Company Name> account.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not make express or implied warranty statements unless doing so is part of their normal job duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not cause security breaches or disrupt network communications, including unauthorized data or account access, network sniffing, ping floods, packet spoofing, denial-of-service activity, account brute-forcing, or malicious forged routing information, unless authorized activities are within their regular duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Port scanning or security scanning is prohibited unless prior notification is provided to the Infosec Team.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not execute network monitoring that intercepts data not intended for their host unless the activity is part of their normal job duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not circumvent user authentication or the security of any host, network, or account.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not introduce honeypots, honeynets, or similar technology on the <Company Name> network.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not interfere with or deny service to any user other than the employee's host.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not use programs, scripts, commands, or messages with the intent to interfere with or disable another user's terminal session, whether locally or through the Internet, Intranet, or Extranet.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not provide information about, or lists of, <Company Name> employees to external parties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Whenever employees state an affiliation with the company while using company resources, they must clearly indicate that their opinions are their own and not necessarily those of the company.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not send unsolicited email messages, junk mail, or advertising material to individuals who did not specifically request it.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Harassment by email, telephone, text, or paging is prohibited, whether based on the language, frequency, or size of messages.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Unauthorized use or forgery of email header information is prohibited.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not solicit email for an address other than the poster's account with the intent to harass or collect replies.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not create or forward chain letters, Ponzi schemes, or other pyramid schemes.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not use unsolicited email originating from <Company Name>'s networks or other Internet, Intranet, or Extranet providers to advertise a service hosted by <Company Name> or connected through its network.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Users must not post the same or similar non-business messages to large numbers of Usenet newsgroups.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employee blogging and social-media activity is subject to this policy whether performed using <Company Name> property and systems or personal computer systems.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Limited and occasional blogging or other online posting using <Company Name> systems is permitted only when conducted professionally and responsibly, compliant with company policy, not detrimental to <Company Name>'s best interests, and not disruptive to regular work duties.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Blogging or other online posting from <Company Name> systems is subject to monitoring.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must comply with the Confidential Information policy when blogging and must not reveal confidential or proprietary information, trade secrets, or other material protected by that policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must not engage in blogging that may harm or tarnish the image, reputation, or goodwill of <Company Name> or its employees.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must not make discriminatory, disparaging, defamatory, or harassing comments when blogging or otherwise engage in conduct prohibited by the Non-Discrimination and Anti-Harassment policy.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must not attribute personal statements, opinions, or beliefs to <Company Name> when blogging.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: When expressing personal beliefs or opinions in blogs, employees must not expressly or implicitly represent themselves as an employee or representative of <Company Name>.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees assume all risk associated with blogging.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: Employees must follow all laws governing the handling and disclosure of copyrighted or export-controlled materials in connection with blogging or social-media activity.

title: Acceptable Use Standard
definition: <Company Name> trademarks, logos, and other intellectual property must not be used in connection with blogging or social-media activity.
